error.url: Enter the full link, for example https://www.example.com.

error.email: Enter a valid email address, for example eva@example.com.
error.phone: Enter the phone number as digits and spaces, for example +420 777 123 456.

translation.inline: Translation missing: {languages}. The website will show the available language.
translation.title: Translations
translation.single: The website has a single language, so no translation is missing. You can add another language under General.
translation.ok: Every text you have filled in is translated into all website languages.
translation.hint: These texts are filled in for only some of the languages. You can still publish: guests in the missing language will see the available version of the text.
general.title: General
general.endsOnHint: Fill in only for a multi-day wedding.
general.languagesHint: You enter texts in each language separately. At least one language must stay on.
general.defaultLocaleHint: When a text is missing in a language, guests will see the main language.
general.templateHint: The template changes the look and typeface; the content stays the same.
general.paletteHint: Every palette meets the WCAG 2.2 contrast requirements, so text on the website stays readable.
general.paletteBad: Contrast is too low, this palette cannot be published
block.hero.title: Introduction
block.hero.help: The introduction with names and date is always first and always on. Change names and date under General.
block.hero.countdown: Show a countdown to the wedding
block.hero.taglineHint: A short line under the names, for example “Celebrating in the garden”.
block.hero.photoHint: Shown across the whole introduction behind the names (Eucalyptus template). We recommend a landscape photo in a 3 : 2 ratio, at least 2400 × 1600 px, as JPEG (PNG or WebP also work, up to 40 MB). On phones the photo is cropped to portrait, so keep the main subject in the centre. Upload the photo in the Photos block first and give it a description.
block.hero.photoEmpty: You have no processed photo with a description yet. Upload one in the Photos block.
block.program.title: Programme
block.program.help: The programme of the day, hour by hour. Events are also used for invitations and RSVPs.
block.venue.title: Venue
block.venue.help: Where the wedding takes place. A text address is always shown; the map link is only an extra.
block.lodging.title: Accommodation and transport
block.lodging.help: Where guests can stay and how to get there.
block.dresscode.title: Dress code
block.faq.title: FAQ
block.faq.help: Answers to what guests ask most often.
block.contact.title: Contact
block.story.title: Our story
block.story.help: How you met, in your own words.
block.gifts.title: Gifts
block.gifts.help: An account number and QR payment for guests who want to contribute. Guests see it only after entering the PIN.
block.gallery.title: Photos
block.gallery.help: Upload your own photos, or add a link to a gallery elsewhere, for example your photographer’s. Every photo needs a description.
block.rsvp.title: RSVP
block.rsvp.help: The form guests use to confirm they are coming.
venue.title: Venues
venue.name: Venue name
venue.addressHint: Street, number and town. The text address is always shown on the website.
venue.private: Show the address only after guests enter the PIN
venue.privateHint: For a private venue (for example your parents’ garden) only a guest who enters the PIN from the invitation sees the address. Without the PIN it is not even in the page source.
venue.mapHint: Optional. Your own link, for example to a shared route.
venue.shownHint: Tick the venues guests should see.
venue.showMapHint: A map (OpenStreetMap, loaded through our website) appears below the venues, with links to Google Maps and Mapy.cz for each public venue. Private venues are never on the map.
venue.geo.searching: Looking up the address on the map…
venue.geo.found: The venue is on the map. Check it in the preview.
venue.geo.not_found: We could not find this address on the map. Try adding the street, house number and town.
venue.geo.limited: Map search is busy right now. We will try again when you edit the address.
venue.geo.error: The address could not be looked up. The venue will not appear on the map.
events.title: Programme events
events.hint: Add the ceremony, the reception and any other part of the day. Events are listed by time on the website.
events.name: Event name
events.endBefore: The end must be after the start.
events.rsvp: Guests confirm attendance for this event
events.removeNote: Removing the event also cancels the guests’ invitations to it.
lodging.name: Name of the accommodation
lodging.urlHint: Optional. You can also type just www.guesthouse.com.
lodging.addressHint: Optional. Street, number and town; shown with the accommodation and lets it appear on the map.
lodging.mapNeedsAddress: The accommodation appears on the map once you fill in its address. The map is in the Venue section.
lodging.transportHint: For example connections, parking or a ride from the ceremony.
faq.question: Question
contact.name: Name
story.hint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
gifts.pinNote: Guests see the account number and QR payment only after entering the PIN from the invitation.
gifts.pinMissing: The guest PIN is not switched on yet, so nobody will see this. You can switch it on under Access.
gifts.accountHint: For example 19-2000145399/0800. For a foreign account enter the IBAN.
gifts.bicHint: For foreign guests, 8 or 11 characters, e.g. KOMBCZPP. The English version of the website shows it next to the IBAN.
gifts.message: Message for the recipient in the payment (optional)
gifts.messageHint: Up to 60 characters, without diacritics. The donor chooses the amount.
gifts.qrCaption: QR payment without a fixed amount, IBAN {iban}.
gallery.enableLink: Add a link to an external photo gallery
gallery.urlHint: Only a link starting with https://. The website just links to this address and loads nothing from it.
gallery.label: Gallery name
gallery.labelHint: Optional. Overrides the name we find on the gallery page.
gallery.status.ok: The link preview has been loaded.
gallery.status.failed: The preview could not be loaded. The link will show on the website with the address and the name you enter above. You can still save the link.
gallery.status.limited: You have refreshed the preview too often. Try again in an hour; the link is saved without it.
gallery.status.error: The preview could not be loaded. You can still save the link.
gallery.cardFound: We took this from the target page:
gallery.cardFallback: Without a preview the website shows the name from the field above, or the gallery address.
gallery.protected: Show the link only after guests enter the PIN
gallery.protectedHint: A link with a secret token is itself access to the gallery: anyone who knows it can see the gallery. If not every visitor should see it, switch this on. The link and its preview are then visible only to a guest with the PIN.
rsvp.settingsNote: You set the deadline, the questions for guests and the guest list in guest management.
blocks.title: Website sections
blocks.hint: Switch on the sections you want on the website and put them in order with the up and down buttons, or drag them with the mouse. The introduction is always first.

view.label: View

preview.frameTitle: Live preview of the wedding website

history.autoNote: State when the editor was opened
history.restoreQuestion: Restore version {version}? The current draft is first saved as a restore point. Guests’ invitations to events that are not in that version will be cancelled.
history.restored: Version {version} is loaded as a draft. Check it and then publish it.
history.error.notFound: We could not find this version.
history.error.conflict: The website changed in another window in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
history.error.generic: The version could not be restored. Please try again.

picker.intro: You manage more than one wedding. Choose the one you want to edit.
picker.error: The wedding could not be switched. Please try again.
help.title: Help
help.intro: Short answers for each part of the administration. You will find help on every screen in the same place, at the far right of the main menu.
help.contact: Did not find an answer? Write to us at podpora@se-vezmou.cz.
help.overview.title: My website
help.overview.body: The overview shows whether the website is published and whether the draft has unpublished changes. If you manage more than one wedding, you pick the one to edit here. A quick change shows guests a banner at the top of the website, immediately and without publishing again.
help.site.title: Edit website
help.site.body: Changes are saved automatically. Guests see only the published version; only you see the draft, and the live preview. You switch sections on and put them in order with the up and down buttons or by dragging. You enter texts in each website language separately. If a translation is missing, the website shows the available language and we tell you about it.
help.publish.title: Publishing and taking offline
help.publish.body: The Publish changes button creates a new version of the website that guests will see. Taking the website offline hides it from guests; the address stays yours and nothing is deleted. A restore point saves the state of the draft to the history without publishing anything.
help.history.title: Version history
help.history.body: You can restore an old version as a draft. The current draft is first saved as a restore point, so you can go back again. The restored version is published only by your explicit step.
help.privacy.title: Details behind the PIN
help.privacy.body: The account number, the address of a private venue and a protected gallery link are not in the public part of the website. Guests see them only after entering the PIN from the invitation. Without the guest PIN switched on, nobody sees them.
help.gallery.title: Photos and a link to a gallery
help.gallery.body: Upload your own photos (up to 12) and write a description for each, which a screen reader reads out. The site does not publish a photo without a description unless you mark it as decorative. We remove the location and other data from the photo and make smaller versions of it. You can add a large gallery, for example your photographer’s, as a link: when you save the link we load the title, description and image of the target page once. Guests do not load any foreign page or foreign image when they view the site. You can protect both the photos and the link with the guest PIN.
photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: You can upload up to {max} of your own photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP, each up to {size} MB and {mp} megapixels). We resize them, rotate them and remove the location and other data from the photo.
photos.addHint: You can choose several files at once. They upload one after another.
photos.full: You have uploaded {max} photos, which is the maximum. Delete one to add another.
photos.unavailable: Photo uploads are not available right now because storage is not set up. Please contact us so we can fix it.
photos.error.type: We do not accept this type of file. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
photos.error.heic: We do not support HEIC. On an iPhone choose the most compatible format when picking from the library, or export the photo to JPEG.
photos.error.too_large: The file is larger than {size} MB.
photos.error.quota: The photo did not fit into the limit of {max} photos.
photos.error.network: The upload failed, probably because of the network. Try again.
photos.error.limited: Too many files were uploaded in a short time. Try again in a moment.
photos.error.unavailable: Photo storage is not available right now.
photos.error.closed: The site can no longer be edited, or you were signed out. Sign in again.
photos.error.busy: Processing is taking unusually long. Try again.
photos.error.unsupported_type: The file is not JPEG, PNG or WebP (the content of the file decides, not the extension).
photos.error.too_many_pixels: The image has more than {mp} megapixels.
photos.error.corrupt: The file is damaged or incomplete.
photos.error.missing_file: The file did not reach storage. Try again.
photos.error.storage: Storage is not working right now. Try again in a moment.
photos.error.expired: The upload expired. Upload the photo again.
photos.error.internal: Processing failed. Try again, or upload a different file.
photos.caption: Photo description
photos.captionHint: Briefly describe what is in the photo. Screen readers read it and it is shown when the photo is enlarged. Without a description the photo is not published unless you mark it as decorative.
photos.decorativeHint: Screen readers skip it. Use it only for ornamental images, not for photos of the two of you.
photos.noCaption: No description: the photo is not published until you add one or mark it as decorative.
photos.saveFailed: The description could not be saved. Try again.
photos.dragHint: Change the order by dragging, or with the Up and Down buttons.
photos.deleteQuestion: Delete photo {n} for good? It disappears from the already published site too and cannot be restored.
photos.deleteFailed: The photo could not be deleted. Try again.
photos.pending: The upload did not finish. Delete it and upload again.
photos.failed: The photo could not be processed: {reason}
photos.protected: Show the photos only after entering the guest PIN
photos.protectedHint: Without the PIN from the invitation the photos are not on the site and cannot be opened by direct address either.
photos.exportHint: Links to the largest version of each photo. The links are valid only for a short while.
photos.exportEmpty: There is nothing to download yet.
photos.exportFailed: The links could not be created. Try again.
photos.exportLimited: You asked for links too often. Try again in an hour.
issue.photoNoCaption: A photo without a description is not published. Add a description, or mark it as decorative.
